caption: The drawing depicts a glass bottle in the shape of a fish, standing upright against an off-white or cream-colored background. The bottle is predominantly amber or yellow-brown in color and has a glossy appearance, giving it a transparent or translucent quality that simulates the look of glass. The bottle features detailed carvings, including an eye, gills, pectoral fin, and rows of overlapping scales along its body, all accentuated with darker shadows and highlights to create a three-dimensional effect. The fish's mouth forms the bottle's opening, with a narrow neck and a slightly flared rim at the top. The tail of the fish is flat and serves as the base, allowing the bottle to stand independently. The object is centrally composed within the drawing, and there is no visible background detail beyond the plain surface. In the bottom right corner, small text is visible, reading “J.S. MARKUSEN K.C., MISSOURI.”
title: Fish Bitters Bottle
